asr.full_text: Hello friends, I have created this video just to give you information. So what the government has announced that people who are 18 years old and 45 years old now can get vaccinated, many people may still have doubts about how the vaccination process will be. Can we go directly here and get vaccinated? So this is exactly what registration is. All this I'll tell you. There are also some important points that you should pay attention to. We'll also discuss. The drive was open for those who are health care workers who were being vaccinated here after what the government did is that for people over 60 and finally 45 years old the vaccination was opened up but finally the government went here to vaccinate all the people over 18 years old. Keep in mind that the registration process will start two days before when it will be done today when I am recording this video from 4 pm on 28th April and I would like to ask you to take care of the family as much as possible. You have to keep in mind that here is the Kovin platform and Aarogya Setu and what is its process and what is the documentation will be the same as the rest of the people who were 45 years old and the same as the process was the same. You will go and you will see that this front page will see you open, you can see that at the top of this front page you can see here sign in yourself is written, above it you have to go, then you will have another new page will open, inside this page you can see you will have to upload all the documents like your identity, age, gender, where you live. Every name that is will be taken from you here. Then in the next step you will be asked for a proof of identity. You will get the address of your home and the pin code. Then you will get the hospital that is there. That means wherever you put the pin in your Delhi if you live. 1100, 06, 1100, whatever area you are living in. You will put the pin according to that pin through any hospital in your area. The list of vaccines that are being administered will open up before you. You have seen that the government has registered people over 45 years old, especially people over 60 years old who may not be able to use their mobile phone, who may not be able to go through the app, so here they were told that if you are in hospitals wherever it looks in the middle, they all have to register online here, which I told you here and then you can get vaccinated. What does this mean that private hospitals have to get a vaccine directly from the manufacturer like who is the manufacturer your serum institute India became biotech co-vaccine then you have to talk to them directly here cheating private hospitals here get a vaccine and that vaccine will be charged now what will it cost if you tell private hospitals then you just have to click and go to see exactly what the prices are being told for private hospital but these private hospitals will decide on this. Now look at this vaccine is being made, which vaccine is being made inside our country. You have to understand why this is 50% of the vaccine. Because even if people over 45 are getting their vaccination, they have to get their second dose, then the central government will handle all of this with its own hop, taking 50% of the vaccine and distributing it to different states according to the number of cases in Maharashtra, which is more than the population. Now what is happening here is that the number of people between 18 and 45 years old who have their vaccine, if you go to the government hospital, depends on which state you are in. It's a way of liberalizing the vaccine, which means giving power to the states, giving power to private hospitals, so what does that mean, that the vaccine will get you into the market, you can buy it directly from the medical store, no, not yet, the pharmacist here, the chemist shop, the vaccine is not available.
